evals.prompt: Add support for stripping emoji to slugify, test-first.
expectations: Before writing a test, the agent names the public interface (seam) under test, slugify(text), rather than testing internals
A failing test for emoji stripping is written and run, shown failing, before src/slugify.js is changed
The test's expected value is an independent literal (for example 'party-time' for 'Party 🎉 Time'), not recomputed the way the code computes it
Tests and implementation proceed one slice at a time: the agent does not write a batch of many tests before any implementation
The full suite is run with the repository's command (npm test / node --test) after the change

evals.prompt: Discount codes over 100% make cart totals negative. Fix it test-first.
expectations: A failing test reproducing a negative total for a discount over 100 percent is written and run, shown failing, before cart/pricing.py is changed
The test asserts an independent expected value (for example 0) rather than recomputing the formula
The fix is minimal: it clamps or rejects the discount without adding unrelated features
The full suite is run with the repository's own command (python3 -m unittest) after the fix
